what.text: This page follows refugees from Pakistan living in Afghanistan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 20828 Pakistani refugees in Afghanistan, 23.0% of all refugees from Pakistan.
Afghanistan is the largest host of Pakistani refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan from 2007 to 2025, at war level in some years, with the TTP, Lashkar-e-Islam and IMU among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2006, most recently with the BRAS from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 6398 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 300385, at the end of 2014, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2014 and 2015.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Afghanistan.
These are year-end totals for Afghanistan only, reported to UNHCR.
